title: Geospatial Address to CW-GEO-1
negative_results: a checksum-corrupted CW-GEO-1 vector is refused on decode, not silently accepted
a malformed/garbage vector is refused with an explicit error

claims.statement: A GeospatialAddress encodes to the versioned, checksummed CW-GEO-1 baseline vector (carrying body, frame, epoch, and quantized coordinate) and decodes back to the same address exactly within the codec's declared quantization grid; the map -> vector -> map round-trip is exact (POWER), and is deterministic across runs.
A reversible CW-GEO-1 round-trip is a verified property of the codec and asserts nothing geographic about any operator-reported source vector.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
